messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE AND SUBJECT TO CONTRACT — P Marsden / Harrow Precision Engineering
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Whitlock,

We act for Harrow Precision Engineering Limited. Please find attached a without-prejudice letter, written as part of a protected conversation under s.111A ERA 1996, setting out an offer to your client in full and final settlement. In short: £95,000 ex gratia, a pro-rated FY25 bonus of £24,850, accrued holiday, outplacement and a £1,500 legal-fee contribution, plus an agreed reference. The offer is open until 5pm on 27 February.

We would welcome a without-prejudice call.

Kind regards,
Sarah

Sarah Whitfield | Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you. We are taking instructions. Our client's position is that this is a protected-disclosure dismissal and that your opening figure materially understates his loss; we will send a schedule of loss shortly. We are, however, willing to engage constructively to avoid proceedings. A call next week would be helpful.

Regards,
Alistair Whitlock
Partner, Pemberton Rowe LLP
5 Temple Row, Birmingham B2 5LG
